package example
import (
 "fmt"
 "net"
 "net/rpc"
 "os"
 "strings"
 "testing"
 "time"
 sieve "sieve.client"
)
type CoverageObserver struct{ Records chan sieve.NotifyTestCoverageRequest }
func (o *CoverageObserver) NotifyTestCoverage(r *sieve.NotifyTestCoverageRequest,response *sieve.Response) error{o.Records<-*r;response.Ok=true;return nil}
func TestObservedReconciliation(t *testing.T){
 observer:=&CoverageObserver{make(chan sieve.NotifyTestCoverageRequest,4)};server:=rpc.NewServer();if err:=server.RegisterName("TestCoordinator",observer);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 listener,err:=net.Listen("tcp","127.0.0.1:0");if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};defer listener.Close()
 go func(){connection,err:=listener.Accept();if err==nil{defer connection.Close();server.ServeConn(connection)}}()
 os.Setenv("sieveTestPlan",fmt.Sprintf(`{"sieveServerAddr":%q,"actions":[],"annotatedReconcileStackFrame":["example.(*Reconciler).Reconcile"],"coverageResources":["secret/default/example"]}`,listener.Addr().String()));defer os.Unsetenv("sieveTestPlan")
 r:=&Reconciler{};value,err:=r.Reconcile(3);if value!=6||err!=nil||r.Calls!=1{t.Fatal("normal result changed")}
 value,err=r.Reconcile(-1);if value!=-1||err==nil||r.Calls!=2{t.Fatal("early return changed")}
 previous:="";instance:=""
 for i,kind:=range []string{"begin","end","begin","end"}{
  select{case record:=<-observer.Records:
   if record.Kind!=kind||record.Frame!="example.(*Reconciler).Reconcile"||record.InvocationID==""||!strings.Contains(record.InstanceID,"*example.Reconciler@"){t.Fatalf("invalid invocation %+v",record)}
   if i%2==0{if previous==record.InvocationID{t.Fatal("invocation reused")};previous=record.InvocationID;instance=record.InstanceID}else if previous!=record.InvocationID||instance!=record.InstanceID{t.Fatal("unpaired end")}
  case <-time.After(2*time.Second):t.Fatal("instrumented test-mode invocation evidence missing")}
 }
}
